verdict: Snowflake grew revenue 29% to $1,213M, with product revenue of $1,158M — but $1,152M of running costs, much of it share-based pay, kept the GAAP result a $292M net loss.

segments.name: Product
segments.note: Customers paying to store and crunch data on Snowflake's platform, billed by how much they use. Up 29% YoY.

segments.name: Professional services and other
segments.note: Consulting, training and support that help customers get set up. Up 30% YoY.

opex.name: Sales and marketing
opex.note: Sales teams and marketing. Up 26% YoY.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: Building the platform and its AI products. Up 12% YoY.

opex.name: General and administrative
opex.note: The back office — finance, legal and admin. Up 1% YoY.

follow100Note: Running costs took $94.94 of every $100 of revenue — share-based pay to staff is a large part of Snowflake's GAAP expenses.
otherDetail: Other income of $42M net was $45M of interest income on Snowflake's cash and investments, minus $2M of interest expense and $2M of other expense, net. Net loss attributable to Snowflake Inc. was $294M (EPS -$0.87), after $2M of income attributable to noncontrolling interests.
footerNote: Snowflake's fiscal year ends Jan 31, so this is Q3 FY26. Non-GAAP operating income was $131M — the gap to GAAP is mostly share-based pay.

takeaways.title: Product growth held near 30%
takeaways.text: Product revenue rose 29% to $1,158M, the net revenue retention rate was 125%, and remaining performance obligations (booked future work) jumped 37% to $7.88B.

takeaways.title: Adjusted profit, GAAP loss — the gap is share pay
takeaways.text: Non-GAAP operating income was $131M (an 11% margin), but GAAP showed a $329M operating loss and a $292M net loss, mostly because of stock-based compensation.

takeaways.title: Big customers kept spending
takeaways.text: Snowflake ended the quarter with 688 customers spending over $1M a year on the platform (+29% YoY) and 766 Forbes Global 2000 customers; adjusted free cash flow was $136M.

sources.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended Oct 31, 2025 (SEC EDGAR)
